9._section_summary: This section presents findings from a confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) of the Standard Chinese translation of the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2). The study found that a one-dimensional model with all items loading onto a single factor had adequate fit, consistent with the parent model and translations in other languages (Cantonese and Persian). Body appreciation scores showed good internal consistency and convergent validity, with significant associations to life satisfaction, self-esteem, and in women only, weight discrepancy and BMI. The CFA results also demonstrated that the one-dimensional model was invariant across sex, with no significant differences in body appreciation scores between women and men.
